{{Quote|If the shields are down, the marines can crack the cargo doors, no problem. One assault boat should do it &mdash; it will also serve to draw enemy fire, showing us which guns are still operable and must be taken out before the transport gets within range.|Anna Seertay|<ref name="Minutes" />}}
'''Anna Seertay''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]]. She assisted in the planning of [[Operation Cobolt]] under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine's]] command. Seertay commanded the marine detachment that was charged with breaching the an [[Imperial orbital base]] over [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]] in an [[Assault boat/Legends|assault boat]] and securing a temporary airlock to allow further assault forces to enter the station and secure an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Scandoc decoding computer]].<ref name="Minutes" /> She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the operation; General Madine requested permission to posthumously promote and honor her with a commendation.<ref name="Report" />
